# `streaming_completion_rate_valid`

> The completion rate is completions over plays, so it must be between 0 and 1.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [streaming](README.md) |
| Layer | **gold** — evaluated by the `gold` gate |
| Model | `gld_streaming__daily_content_engagement` (`streaming_gold_staging.gld_streaming__daily_content_engagement`) |
| Column | `completion_rate` |
| Check | `value_between` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/streaming/gold/_gold.yml](../../../dbt/models/streaming/gold/_gold.yml) |

## What it checks

`completion_rate` is between 0 and 1 (inclusive).

## When it fails

The `gold` task of `medallion_streaming` fails, `publish_gold` doesn't run, and the batch is never added to `streaming_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.streaming_completion_rate_valid`.

## Tested by

No sample-data scenario trips this rule yet: it guards against cases the generators don't produce.
